fields.description: A rune derived from {{ rules.name }} marks the item; the GM decides its exact function and strength.
The item is visibly damaged; the GM decides whether that has any concrete consequences.
The item comes from a distant age; the GM decides what its history means in play.
The item is associated with {{ affliction.name }}; the GM decides how the curse manifests.
The item is associated with the {{ status_effect.name }} status effect; the GM decides how the curse manifests.
The presence of {{ animal.name }} inhabits or influences the item.
The presence of {{ companion.name }} inhabits or influences the item.
The presence of {{ monster.name }} inhabits or influences the item.
The item was made, issued, modified, or marked by {{ faction.name }}.
